summary: Blank-page investigation plus regression. PREVIEW (new build): signed-out / redirects to /sign-in, and the full page (marketing copy, Clerk box with email field and Google button) renders at 1920x800 and 1024x1366. /sign-up also renders. A reload with existing localStorage works. Corrupting every existing localStorage key with invalid JSON (including __clerk_environment and enavlog-theme) still renders. Valid JSON with the wrong shape in the enavlog cache keys crashes the page, and it now shows app-error-screen instead of a blank page. 'Clear saved data' recovers and keeps the session. Signed in via ticket: /, /flights, /vatsim, /logbook, /settings and /flights/<id>/briefing all rendered, with the splash shown first and no console errors. Refresh keeps the session. Visiting /sign-in while signed in redirects to /. Sign-out from UserButton returns to /sign-in. Backend 8/8 pass: health, gzip on vatsim/pilots and atc (0.16-0.20s warm), client-errors ok/422, and the AI briefing SSE streams 378 data chunks over about 5s with no Content-Encoding. WebKit is not installed in this sandbox, so only Chromium (with iPad viewport and UA) was tested. ROOT CAUSE REPRODUCED: when Clerk JS fails to load, the OLD build (still on production) shows a 100% blank page on '/'. Real client_errors from a non-test Windows Chrome 156 client on preview show exactly this failure (failed_to_load_clerk_js from keen-piranha-5182.clerk.accounts.dev, repeating every 6-8s, then 'Clerk not loaded after 12s'). The NEW build still dead-ends in this case: an endless 'Loading flight deck…' splash on '/', and no sign-in box and no message on /sign-in.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated, with no rate limit or dedupe. The frontend also posts every window error and unhandled rejection, so one client in a reload loop writes a row every few seconds. Add a per-IP limit or dedupe, and a TTL index on client_errors.at.

On the public URL, /health is routed to the frontend and returns index.html. It returns 200 JSON only on backend port 8001, which is what the platform probe uses, so this is expected. /api/health returns 404.

ui_bugs.component: App.js Protected + ClerkAuthProvider (Clerk JS load failure)
ui_bugs.issue: If clerk-js can't be loaded (content blocker, privacy DNS, network filter, 15s script timeout), isLoaded never becomes true. '/' then shows Splash 'Loading flight deck…' forever. /sign-in shows the marketing half only, with no form and no message. The only reaction is a silent reportError. Reproduced by aborting **/*clerk.accounts.dev/** on preview. In the OLD production build, aborting /api/__clerk/npm/** gives a completely blank '/' (body innerText length 0), which matches the user's report.

read() returns any parsed JSON without checking its shape, and HomePage, FlightsPage, VatsimPage and FlightProcessPage use it in their first useState render. A string or object for 'flights', [null] in the list, non-array vatsim_friends, or {} for a flight crashes rendering: 'all.filter is not a function', 'flights.map is not a function', 'friends is not iterable', computeNavlog '.map of undefined'. The new ErrorBoundary catches this, but the 'Reload' button does not fix it because the same cache is read again. Only 'Clear saved data' does. In the old build this was a permanent blank page.

integration_issues.issue: From this container, https://navdeck.online and https://www.navdeck.online fail the TLS handshake (sslv3 alert handshake failure, Cloudflare IPs). http://navdeck.online returns Cloudflare 'error code: 1001' (DNS resolution error). clerk.navdeck.online 302-redirects to navlog-pilot.emergent.host instead of pointing to Clerk's Frontend API. The publishable key pk_live encodes clerk.navdeck.online. FAPI currently works only because proxy_url=/api/__clerk is used. An iPad home-screen icon saved from navdeck.online would open an error page. The custom-domain DNS/SSL needs checking; it did NOT 302 as the briefing assumed.

issues: If localStorage enavlog-theme is anything other than 'dark' or 'light', the shell stays dark but the Clerk card uses the light appearance. Clamp the stored value to 'dark' or 'light'.

action_items: HIGH: Handle Clerk load failure explicitly. @clerk/react 6.17 exports <ClerkFailed>, <ClerkDegraded> and <ClerkLoading>, and also useClerk().status === 'error'. In Protected and on SignInPage/SignUpPage, render a visible screen instead of Splash or an empty box: 'Couldn't reach the sign-in service. Check content blockers or private DNS, then Retry', with a retry button that reloads the page. Also switch the splash note after about 12s instead of only reporting.
HIGH: Publish the new build to production. The old build there renders a completely blank '/' whenever Clerk isn't loaded, because Protected returns null and ClerkAuthProvider returns null.

HIGH: Check the navdeck.online Cloudflare DNS/SSL: TLS handshake failure, error 1001 over HTTP, and clerk.navdeck.online redirecting to the app instead of Clerk FAPI. Tell the user to open https://navlog-pilot.emergent.host directly, or to re-add the home-screen icon from there, until this is fixed.

MEDIUM: Validate cached shapes in utils-app read(). getFlights should return Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter(Boolean) : []. getProfile and getFlight should return an object or null, and vatsim_friends should be guarded with Array.isArray. Optionally make ErrorBoundary 'Reload' clear the enavlog:* keys first.
LOW: Rate-limit or dedupe /api/client-errors and the window error listener (e.g. at most N reports per page load). Add a TTL index on client_errors.
LOW: ErrorBoundary.reset could also unregister the service workers (navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(r => r.forEach(x => x.unregister()))) for a full reset.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Protected: the 12s timer only calls reportError, so the UI never changes from the splash. The user sees an endless loader, which is functionally the same as the blank page.
ClerkAuthProvider: the 20 x 1.5s config retries are fine (the 'Sign-in is unavailable' note appears after 30s). Clerk script failure, a different failure mode, is not covered.
ErrorBoundary.jsx registers the window listeners at module import, which is fine, but nothing throttles them. Clerk emits failed_to_load_clerk_js twice per load (once each for clerk-js and ui).

sw.js stays network-first and doesn't intercept /api or third-party Clerk hosts, so it is not a blank-page cause. The SPA fallback returns index.html with status 200 for missing /static/js chunks, and the SW will cache that HTML under the chunk URL. Low risk because it is network-first. A tab left open across a deploy can still get a ChunkLoadError on lazy pages; the ErrorBoundary will show a Reload button. Not verified, because the dev-server chunk route mock didn't match.

SelectiveGZip: correct. It excludes /api/ai/* by path, and the GZip responder is created per request. The Clerk proxy strips content-encoding and content-length, so gzip re-encoding on /api/__clerk is safe (only checked by reading code; the proxy is production-only and returns 404 on preview).

success_rate.frontend: Normal flows 100%. Failure-mode handling: Clerk-load failure is still a dead end.

seed_data_creation: None. I deleted the client_errors docs I created: TEST_iter8_* rows via a fixture regex on a unique run marker, plus 10 HeadlessChrome docs by _id. I kept the 'test' doc from 22:52 and the Windows Chrome 156 docs, which were not created by me and look like a real client hitting failed_to_load_clerk_js. Local cache keys were only changed in the test browser, and my last run cleared them through app-error-reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_perf_errors_iter8.py -n 0. Ticket: python make_ticket.py (single use). To reproduce the Clerk failure in Playwright: page.context.route('**/*clerk.accounts.dev/**', abort) on preview, or '**/api/__clerk/npm/**' on production. To reproduce the cache crash: localStorage['enavlog:user_3Lq4UfbibPtTeBffoyK96ASOJdT:flights'] = '"<html>"', then open '/'. Pilot flights: ee9720b3-9736-487a-a34f-df926f0bffbd (open, LEIB-EGCC) and f6604740-... (closed). WebKit is not available in the sandbox.
rca of the issue: Most likely cause of 'login page is blank': the Clerk JS bundle never loads in the user's browser (iPad Safari content blockers, private DNS, a privacy extension, or the 15s script timeout on a slow link). The OLD build, which production still runs, then renders nothing at '/': ClerkAuthProvider returns null until config arrives, and Protected's <Show> components both return null while !isLoaded. The user never gets redirected to /sign-in, and on /sign-in the Clerk box renders nothing. Evidence: (1) reproduced on production by aborting /api/__clerk/npm/**, which gives an empty body on '/'. (2) Mongo client_errors contains repeated 'Failed to load Clerk JS, failed to load script: https://keen-piranha-5182.clerk.accounts.dev/npm/@clerk/clerk-js@6/dist/clerk.browser.js' from a Windows Chrome/156 client on preview '/' (22:54-22:59Z), plus 'Clerk not loaded after 12s'. That client is not this test agent, which uses HeadlessChrome. It persists across devices if each one blocks or filters Clerk's domains, or if the user uses navdeck.online: that domain is currently broken (TLS failure / CF 1001), and clerk.navdeck.online does not point to Clerk. A second, state-dependent blank-page path: wrongly shaped JSON in enavlog:<user>:* cache keys crashes the first render. Mitigation: add ClerkFailed/ClerkDegraded or a status==='error' screen with retry, validate cache shapes, fix the custom-domain DNS/SSL, and redeploy.
